name: google-ads-transparency playbook
description: Curated ScreenHand reference for competitor research on Google Ads Transparency Center using region and domain URLs.

steps: Open the region-specific domain URL directly
Read the visible ad count, advertiser labels, and creative detail links
Expand See all ads when present to get a larger sample
guards: Prefer direct ?region=IN&domain={DOMAIN} URLs over homepage typing
Treat ad count and repeated creatives as activity signals, not conversion proof
domain_lookup.why: Direct domain URLs are more stable than the homepage search interaction and expose active Google ad inventory quickly.

steps: Open 3-5 creative detail links from the domain results page
Read advertiser name, headline fragments, and recurrence across creatives
Cross-check landing pages separately for offer and funnel structure
creative_detail_review.why: Creative detail pages help distinguish one-off ads from repeated campaign families.

errors.error: homepage search is less reliable than direct domain lookup
errors.context: Autocomplete and advertiser selection can be inconsistent under automation
errors.solution: Use https://adstransparency.google.com/?region=IN&domain={DOMAIN} as the primary entry point.

errors.error: the tool shows ad inventory, not performance metrics
errors.context: You can confirm active ads but not ROAS, CPL, or conversion counts
errors.solution: Use ad count, creative repetition, and landing-page alignment as outside signals only.
